clips.title: The story
paras: At Lake Falathim, the Glowing Gem lies among the murlocs after Teronis fell seeking it. The stone holds magic needed to restore Dartol's rod.

Murlocs near Lake Falathim hold the Glowing Gem, a stone with latent magic. Teronis, a young night elf from Astranaar, went after it to find a way to push back the corruption spreading through Ashenvale's forests. Teronis died at the lake, but the stone remained intact among the scavengers along the shore.
